hero.body: This hub organizes titanium dioxide grades by application across coatings, plastics, masterbatch, printing inks, paper and specialty materials. Use each collection as a starting point for technical evaluation.

intro.neutral: Grades to Review are starting points for technical evaluation, not rankings or guarantees of suitability.
intro.both: Open a grade page for product information, or explore an application for guidance on what to evaluate.
intro.gradeOnly: Open a grade page for product information.
intro.applicationOnly: Explore an application for guidance on what to evaluate.

evaluation.heading: How to Use This Application Hub

items.title: Choose your application.
items.body: Start with the category that matches what you make. Review more than one path if your work spans several applications.

items.title: Compare technical information.
items.body: Use current technical data to compare the grades under review against your requirements.

items.title: Validate in your own system.
items.body: Check the grade in your formulation and process before making a specification decision.

items.title: Products
items.body: Already know the grade, or need a wider starting point? Use the product directory to review the portfolio and explore process information.

items.title: Documents
items.body: Understand technical, quality and origin document types and how to request them.

items.title: Markets
items.body: Find procurement context for your destination market.

finalRfq.heading: Share Your Application Requirements
paragraphs: Share the intended application, destination market, required quantity and any technical or documentation requirements. Our team will review the request and identify the appropriate next step.
If you have not selected a grade, choose “Not sure / Need help” on the quotation form. For an application that is still undecided, choose “Other / Not sure”.
